chapter_mission: Widen out to the Corellian-front perspective: Wedge Antilles surfaces on Corellia declining to take sides; Syal/Lysa and Doran Tainer glimpsed; Alliance/Corellian alignment pressure rising.
chapter_turn: The book's most recognizable Corellian veteran — Wedge — visibly refuses to commit, which makes the crisis structural rather than personal.

scene_plan.purpose: Wedge declines a Corellian military commission; the scene registers his stubborn independence.
Wedge watching a squadron depart; Syal/Lysa glimpsed but not identified to the reader.

exit_vector: Wedge alone on a Corellian terrace watching the political apparatus grind past him.
notes: Establishes the Wedge-holding-the-center register; the Syal/Lysa hook planted quietly.
